Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the Egon Zehnder homepage by conflating an industry vertical (Private Equity/Private Capital) with the firm’s service field. Despite the page explicitly describing Egon Zehnder as an organizational consulting and leadership advisory (and executive search) firm, the Planner concluded “Private Equity” was the field and prematurely marked the task complete, failing to extract the exact service wording from the site as previously instructed.
